findings.title: Withdrawal from submissive worship opens a protected social order
findings.claim: The worship relation named by yaʿbudūna is also heard as submissive allegiance; when the youths withdraw from that relation and turn toward the cave, the cave becomes a divinely provided alternative social arrangement rather than only a hiding place.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier 18:16:4:1 carries the B003 sense of submission and worship. The withdrawal form, the illā...Allāh exception, and the wider supplied parallels at 19:49 and 39:17 make the contact concrete: departure from rival or coercive worship is followed by a protected place and provision, which changes the cave's function in the reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the retreat as a boundary-making act whose shelter is part of a new allegiance and communal protection, while the plain command to enter the cave remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a qualified wider resonance of the focus's worship-and-withdrawal relation, not a replacement for the literal retreat or a claim that every later social consequence is encoded in 18:16. The target connection rows supply exact Arabic and relation notes but no target morphology or lexical analysis.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus-anchored publication grounds the B003 relation; the parallel reader-walk evidence is legacy_unbound, and the wider connection targets lack target morphology, so the social-order extension remains qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylem, sıradan itaati aşan bir boyun eğme ve alçalma tutumu içerir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperfect worship verb yaʿbudūna carries the relation of worshipful submission from which the youths withdraw.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The withdrawal verb and the named divine exception give the relation a boundary in the focus, while the supplied 19:49 and 39:17 connection rows independently repeat departure from rival worship followed by gift, refuge, or good news.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's act of separation contacts the submission-and-worship carrier, and the wider parallels make that separation function as the opening of a protected alternative allegiance rather than a merely spatial retreat.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cave is newly legible as a place where leaving coercive or rival worship makes room for divine provision and another social order.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not make the social-order resonance the sole meaning of yaʿbudūna or turn the wider parallels into direct target morphology for 18:16.

findings.title: Spread mercy opens toward revival and public consequence
findings.claim: The promise expressed by yanshur can be heard as mercy opening and spreading outward, while its supplied revival branch lets that spreading reach a later return to life and public consequence; the protection therefore extends beyond the closed shelter.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier 18:16:10:1 carries the B001 act of opening and spreading. The 42:28 connection returns through the same spreading-mercy relation, and the 50:11 connection supplies a distinct revival trigger for B002; their contact changes the promise from an image of increased mercy into a process whose effects emerge after concealment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the mercy as a movement from enclosure toward renewed life and visible consequence, while still recovering the direct promise that the Lord will spread mercy for the youths in the cave.
findings.containment: The B002 revival line is a qualified secondary resonance, not a claim that yanshur directly means bodily resurrection here or that the spread reading displaces the ordinary mercy promise. The supplied 44:35 connection preserves a contrary boundary around the resurrection association, and the wide reader-walk source is legacy_unbound.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication explicitly anchors both branches at the focus; the wider spread reading is also carried by a legacy_unbound walk, and the connection targets provide Arabic and relation notes without target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kumaş, kitap, sayfa, eşya veya bulut gibi bir şeyi açmak, sermek ve yüzeye yaymak temel işlemdir.
branch_activations.carrier: The jussive verb yanshur carries the ordinary action of spreading the Lord's mercy for the youths.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 42:28 connection repeats spreading mercy after constriction, giving the focus carrier a wider opening-and-outward-motion contact.
branch_activations.activation: The focus promise contacts the independent spreading-mercy scene, so spread becomes a process that opens what was enclosed rather than only a larger quantity of mercy.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Mercy begins in the protected cave and is newly legible as something that can unfold outward from it.
branch_activations.boundary: This activation preserves the local promise and does not claim that every use of the root or every later outcome is active here.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ölmüş olanın yeniden yaşama durumuna geçmesi temel sonuçtur.
branch_activations.carrier: The same jussive yanshur is the focus carrier whose spreading action is connected to the supplied revival facet.

branch_activations.activation: The spreading carrier meets revival scenes in the supplied wider evidence, allowing the protected interval to be read as opening toward renewed life and disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promised mercy can remain in the cave as protection while also carrying a qualified horizon of revival and public emergence.
branch_activations.boundary: The revival facet is an attributed secondary resonance, not a direct grammatical gloss of yanshur; the contrary 44:35 connection remains part of the boundary.

findings.title: Prepared mirfaq as usable ease
findings.claim: The indefinite mirfaq at the end of the ayah can carry a wider image of prepared, accessible support: the cave's ease is a real provision within the story, and the same-sura mirfaq contrasts show how that support acquires value through its relation to other resting places.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier 18:16:19:1 lands on the accepted B003 facility branch. The supplied 18:31 and 18:29 connection rows return through the same mirfaq relation and place the cave's prepared ease beside later good and bad resting-place scenes, changing the final promise from an abstract convenience into a bounded, usable refuge.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the closing promise as something arranged for practical use in the youths' affair, while the cave remains the ordinary physical shelter named by the ayah.
findings.containment: This finding is an uncandidate activation from the available branch and same-surah connection evidence, not a claim that the cave is the final abode or that the later target rows supply full morphology for the focus. The relation remains qualified and retains the temporary, bounded character of the cave's help.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and accepted branch facet are supplied directly, while the same-surah connection rows supply exact target Arabic and relation notes but explicitly omit target morphology and lexical analysis.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yarar ve rahatlık sağlayan, kolay erişilen olanak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işte rahatlık, uygunluk ve yarar sağlayan olanak ya da koşulu bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The indefinite noun mirfaq names an available means of comfort or support prepared within the youths' affair.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The same-surah connection rows at 18:31 and 18:29 return the mirfaq relation through contrasting good and bad resting places, supplying an independent measure of what the cave's prepared ease does.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's open-ended support contacts the later resting-place contrast, so the promised ease becomes a concrete and bounded refuge whose value is visible against other possible abodes.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final promise is newly legible as practical support arranged for use, not merely a general statement that help will exist.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains the facility-and-ease sense; the connection rows do not license importing their full target morphology or making the cave identical with the later abodes.
